mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, m.NAME AS name, TO_CHAR(m.BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, m.EMAIL AS email, m.PHONE AS phone, m.ZIP AS zip, m.ADDR1 AS addr1, m.ADDR2 AS addr2, m.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(m.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(m.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updateAt, TO_CHAR(m.LAST_LOGIN_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS lastLoginAt, m.FAILURE_CNT AS failureCnt, m.SNS_PROVIDER AS snsProvider, m.SNS_ID AS snsId,r.ROLE_NAME AS roleName, m.ROLE_ID AS roleId FROM MEMBER m JOIN APP_ROLE r ON m.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE m.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT h.STATUS_HIST_ID AS statusHistId, h.BEFORE_STATUS AS beforeStatus, h.AFTER_STATUS AS afterStatus, h.REASON AS reason, TO_CHAR(h.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS startAt, a.Name AS adminName FROM MEMBER_STATUS_HIST h LEFT JOIN MEMBER a ON h.ADMIN_ID = a.MEMBER_ID WHERE h.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.STATUS_HIST_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET FAILURE_CNT = 0 WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET NAME = #{name}, BIRTH = TO_DATE(#{birth}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ROLE_ID = #{roleId}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
